reports.title: BioMarin Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Full-Year Financial Guidance (in millions, except EPS amounts)
section: •Revenue: Total Revenues, Metabolic Conditions, and VOXZOGO guidance updated to reflect uncertainty in the timing of multiple orders from a single international customer.

•Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: BioMarin expects the Alesta acquisition and BMN 450 license agreement to result in total pre-tax charges of approximately $320 million and $83 million, respectively, for the full year 2026, consisting of the acquired IPR&D charges and ongoing operating expenses, representing an unfavorable impact of approximately $1.55 and $0.32, respectively, to both GAAP Diluted EPS and Non-GAAP Diluted EPS for the full year 2026.
